dogecoin.text: Dogecoin has the same algorithm as Litecoin does, but with some modifications. Blocks are created once a minute, i.e. 2.5 times faster. Therefore, transaction confirmation times are faster, taking about 6 minutes. Meanwhile, Bitcoin transactions go through in an hour.
